questions.description: 用条件语句求三个数的最大值与最小值。
判断年份并输出完整描述。
实现分数化简（求最大公约数后约分）。
questions.code_template:
def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a
num, den = 12, 18
g = gcd(num, den)
print(___)
questions.solution:
def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a
num, den = 12, 18
g = gcd(num, den)
print(f"{num}/{den} = {num // g}/{den // g}")

questions.code_template:
a, b, c = 5, 12, 13
if a + b > c and a + c > b and b + c > a:
    s = (a + b + c) / 2
    area = (s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c)) ** 0.5
    print(f"Area: {area:.2f}")
else:
    print(___)
questions.solution:
a, b, c = 5, 12, 13
if a + b > c and a + c > b and b + c > a:
    s = (a + b + c) / 2
    area = (s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c)) ** 0.5
    print(f"Area: {area:.2f}")
else:
    print("Invalid triangle")

questions.description: 模拟红绿灯控制输出。
判断表达式结果的正负。
判断密码强度并输出规则详情。
questions.code_template:
pwd = "P@ssw0rd"
length_ok = len(pwd) >= 8
upper_ok = any(c.isupper() for c in pwd)
digit_ok = any(c.isdigit() for c in pwd)
symbol_ok = any(not c.isalnum() for c in pwd)
score = sum([length_ok, upper_ok, digit_ok, symbol_ok])
if score == 4:
    print("very strong")
elif score == 3:
    print("strong")
elif score == 2:
    print("medium")
else:
    print(___)
questions.solution:
pwd = "P@ssw0rd"
length_ok = len(pwd) >= 8
upper_ok = any(c.isupper() for c in pwd)
digit_ok = any(c.isdigit() for c in pwd)
symbol_ok = any(not c.isalnum() for c in pwd)
score = sum([length_ok, upper_ok, digit_ok, symbol_ok])
if score == 4:

elif score == 3:
    print("strong")
elif score == 2:

else:
